column2: With the old Roman capital of Constantinople under our control and no serious challengers in sight, it is surely time for us to grasp the mantle of Byzantium.
Domination of the Aegean and control of the old Roman capital of Constantinople have placed us in a most fortuitous position. With no Romans left to argue, the Latin Empire could be ours.
With the collapse of royal authority and the disintegration of the French kingdom, it would now seem that the Crown of St. Louis lay vacant. Take it, and rebuild France in your image.
With the collapse of the French kingdom and Valois legitimacy, the situation over the Pyrenees is looking interesting. We should conquer the rich lands of France and move our court to Paris.
These lands have long been ruled by squabbling boyars, bishops and dukes who seek only to enrich themselves and their followers. We should crush them all and unite Russia under a single Tsar.
The ancient lands of the Rus' lay ravaged by bickering native princes and foreign khans alike. A true ruler would reconquer the region and proclaim the Kievan Rus' once more.
Unite the High Kingdom of Ireland
The myriad petty kings of Éire continue to fight one another as much as the English. Let us claim the High Kingship and drive the foreigners into the sea.
By conquering more of these lands and securing Imperial legitimacy, we may expand our local domains and claim the vacant crown of Arles.
By conquering more of these lands and securing Imperial legitimacy, we may expand our local domains and claim the vacant crown of Germany.
By conquering more of these lands and securing Imperial legitimacy, we may expand our local domains and claim the vacant crown of Italy.
By conquering more of these lands and securing Imperial legitimacy, we may expand our local domains and claim the vacant crown of Lotharingia.
Unifying the Holy Roman Empire into a single cohesive state has been the dream of every Emperor since the first. Let us make Charlemagne's dream a reality.
Despite Mamluk and Ottoman pretense to the contrary, there has not been a legitimate caliphate in these lands for many centuries now. Were we to reconquer the region, that could soon change.
Found the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies
With Europe's borders forever changed, the old medieval crowns of Naples and Sicily no longer wield the influence they once did. Let us forge them into a united Kingdom of the Two Sicilies.
Whether we consider ourselves Moldavian, Wallachian or something else, it is a fact that the proud people who occupy these ancient lands do not yet have a unified homeland to call our own.
With the old duchy of Austria seemingly gone forever, there is a power vacuum in the Ostmark. Let us retake the old Habsburg domains and declare ourselves Archduke.
The squabbling city states and trade republics of the Low Countries are rich but yield little influence beyond their borders. By unifying into a single Dutch Republic, the world is our oyster.
The three kingdoms of the North were always destined to be together. Let us unite them by force, and forge the once mighty Kalmar Union into a single realm.
Our proud crusader heritage demands we wrestle the Holy Land from the clutches of our enemies. Once the Holy city is Christian once again, we may rebuild the Kingdom of Heaven anew.
The lands of Meissen and Anhalt fall within the borders of the old Saxon march, which at present lay divided. Were we to unite all of Saxony, our power and prestige would be considerable.
Though Mainz and Trier are Imperial electors with considerable status, our efforts would surely be put to better use were we to unite as the Electoral Palatinate.
The ports and cities of the Hanseatic League bicker and feud with one another, allowing our enemies to outcompete us across Europe. To prevail, we must unite the Hansa by force.
Reduced to a mere emirate, Granada yearns to fulfil the destiny of our ancestors and drive the Christians from these lands. Let us claim the mantle of Córdoba and the title of Caliph.
We Jalayirids are displaced Mongols far from our native lands and surrounded by Arabs and Persians. Let us conquer them both, and restore the Il-Khanate to greatness.
With the old House of Osman extinguished, Anatolia is ripe for reunification. It falls to our Turkish brethren to cleanse these lands, and for you to claim the title of Sultan.
It has long been a dream of the rulers of these ancient shattered realms to reunify them into a single Persian Empire. Follow the great warriors of antiquity by claiming the title of Shah.
The Iberian peninsula has for centuries lay divided between Christian and Muslim realms. The time is ripe for a determined prince to forge a united Kingdom of Spain.
The mighty Chola once held sway over the many realms of southern India and the Deccan, with trade routes to China and vassals as far east as Sumatra. Let us reclaim its mantle and eclipse its glory.
Once among the greatest of India's ancient empires, the Gupta conquered much of the subcontinent and ushered in its Golden Age. Why should your kingdom not strive to do the same?
The vast domains of the Maurya once covered much of India, as great emperors like Ashoka spread their faith and ideas across the map. Your realm could yet surpass his.
With English power finally broken and their kingdom in ruins, it falls to we Scots to unite the island of Great Britain under a single crown. Our time has come - the future belongs to Scotland!
